title.en: A Bearing (mechanical) map of the printed Electric 60 Concrete Pump line
title.zh: 用《轴承 (机械)》给已印的电动60型混凝土泵画一张目录

description.en: Electric 60 Concrete Pump is restated under Bearing (mechanical). Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes Electric 60 Concrete Pump. The published table prints Motor Power 90 kW; Theoretical Output 40 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 35 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.7 m³; Fine Stone Conveying (H / V) 200 m / 600 m; 13 mm Stone (H / V) 150 m / 450 m; 24 mm Stone (H / V) 100 m / 300 m; Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki double pump 112; Dimensions (L×W×H) 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm; Main Unit Weight 3300 kg. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. The content photograph does not add a figure that the table omits.
description.zh: 电动60型混凝土泵放在《轴承 (机械)》的结构下重述。邢台河北品锦机械公布电动60型混凝土泵。已公布参数表印有：电机功率90 kW；理论输送量40 m³/h；最大出口压力35 MPa；料斗容积0.7 m³；细石输送（水平/垂直）200 m / 600 m；13 mm石子（水平/垂直）150 m / 450 m；24 mm石子（水平/垂直）100 m / 300 m；液压泵Kawasaki double pump 112；外形尺寸6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm；整机重量3300 kg。没有印出、因此留空的栏目：缸径、活塞行程、使用寿命、材料牌号。内容照片不会补上参数表没有的数字。
